hooks.command: in=$(cat); case "$in" in *Get-GitHubAppToken*) exit 0;; esac; d=0; case "$in" in *push*) case "$in" in *git*) d=1;; esac;; esac; case "$in" in *"pr create"*) d=1;; esac; [ "$d" = 1 ] && printf '%s' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Token missing in this call.
